newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran annual steel output reaches six mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Iran annual steel output reaches six mln tonnes.

text.p: Iran's production of raw steel increased to six million tonnes in the year to March 20, a rise of 39.5 percent over the previous year, state-run Tehran radio said on Wednesday.

It quoted a senior official of the National Iranian Steel Company (Nisco) as saying the state-owned firm reached its output target of six million tonnes in the Iranian year that ends on March 20, up from 4.3 million tonnes last year.

Nisco has set a target of seven million tonnes next year by raising output to 2.4 million tonnes at its Isfahan steel mill in central Iran, to 2.6 million tonnes at the nearby Mobarakeh complex and to 2 million tonnes at its plant in southwestern city of Ahvaz, the official added.
Iran's parliament has authorised the government to seek $500 million in foreign financing next year to raise annual steel production by three million tonnes and for other projects.
The financing, approved as part of the state budget, would have to be in the form of "buybacks", where the investor recoups his capital by receiving some of the project's production.
Iran plans to raise annual steel production to 10 million tonnes by the end of its second five-year plan in March 2000.
